sentences: The chromatic number is the fewest colors needed to color graph vertices so adjacent vertices receive different colors.
The saved textbook question asks for \(O*(2^{n})\) exact running time using only polynomial space.
The star suppresses polynomial factors, making the exponential base and memory requirement the essential targets.
Meeting both bounds would combine fast subset-based computation with a memory footprint that does not grow exponentially.
This is a dated textbook formulation; the saved note does not provide a review of later algorithms or establish present open status.
